label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Give Value Before You Ask for a Sale
body: Share helpful content, insights, or free resources to build trust and show your audience you care before promoting a product.
caption:
It's tempting to jump straight to selling, especially when you're excited about a new product or service. But think about it: people are more likely to buy from someone they trust and who has already provided them with something useful.
